title: Loading indicator
overview: Show that work is in progress when duration is unknown — region, list, or overlay wait. Not a layout placeholder.
apply_when: Fetching a panel, syncing, a wait that is not the submit control itself.
not_when: Spinner on Submit (button loading), placeholder geometry (skeleton), or step chrome (progress).

vs.why: loading state on the commit control
preserve final layout, not an indeterminate spinner

role.overview: Unknown-duration wait on a region, list, or overlay. Not a layout placeholder.
role.apply_when: Fetching a panel, syncing, a wait that is not the submit control itself.
role.not_when: Spinner on Submit (button loading), placeholder geometry (skeleton), or step chrome (progress).

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: The busy graphic sits on the region that is waiting.
composition.not_when: A page-modal spinner that hides everything with no name.

state.overview: Work is in progress. Duration unknown.
state.not_when: A determinate bar (progress) or a skeleton.

accessibility.overview: The wait has a name (Loading, or the region is aria-busy and labeled).
accessibility.not_when: A spinner with no text or accessible name.

accessibility.overview: Start (and end) of the wait can be announced without stealing typing focus.

keyboard.overview: The spinner is not a tab stop. Controls that still work stay reachable.
